doc: Orbit's GENERIC relation vocabulary: exactly one relation per derivation role (src/extensions/knowledge-v1.mjs ROLES), and nothing more — a starting vocabulary, never an ontology. A project names its own relations as rows in <store>/knowledge/vocabulary/*.json, an organisation in <storeBase>/organization/knowledge/vocabulary/*.json, and an extension may ship rows and interpreters; nothing under src/knowledge/ names any of them, and test/knowledge-vocab.test.mjs holds this file to one row per role.

relations.doc: the object happens, changes or is produced when the subject does
in this context, the object is the mechanism that implements the subject — how, never what
the object is a way to observe that the subject happened
the object is a capability id something needs in order to do or to prove the subject
